description: Immutable origin/main revisions used by the expensive affected-selection correctness qualification. Skip-all and RUN-ALL rows are never included in bounded averages.

samples.rationale: A deterministic docs-only working-tree edit is applied atop this recent immutable origin/main revision because no post-v2 commit is docs-only; executable selection must remain empty.
UI renderers and their DOM tests exercise bounded UI attribution.
PR #1071 changes vitest.config.ts; the executable plan must RUN-ALL and bypass cache, while a graph-only count is reported as non-executable.
PR #1072 changes server, shared, app, UI, and tests-map ownership but must produce a genuine executable subset.
package.json and package-lock.json dependency changes are justified whole-unit invalidators.
Role YAML, tool YAML, AGENTS.md, and ordinary docs changed without a directly edited test; declared non-code ownership must select relevant loader and prompt/budget tests.
A shipped marketplace-pack provider/source edit must remain a bounded pack-and-loader selection.
